name: rename-redo-claim
what: rt-converge's 127 class: James renames Drums to T1, undoes it (Drums again), and redoes it just as Bee claims Drums by hand, the two crossing (James and Bee can't reach each other from 58 to 64 s, so James's Redo goes out not knowing). Up to rt-sync2g Bee's computer answered the rename of a track it holds by its old name (sync.set_back) and the Redo was lost everywhere (reproduced at bf500ba: 'Bee has claimed Drums: James's rename to T1 is put back' on all three). Phase 6 (rt-sync2h, option A): nothing is refused or answered on receive, so T1 stands on all three.
signature: intent:James: James's Redo stands: the track is

edits.lua: local c = sync.my_claims(cfg, SONG, ROOM); if c then c.tracks = {}; sync.set_claims(cfg, SONG, ROOM, c) end

checks.what: James's Redo stands: the track is T1
checks.lua: assert(track('T1') and not track('Drums'), 'the track is ' .. tostring((F.tracks[1] or {}).name))
